messages.content: "你能幫我做幾件事嗎？首先，我需要將5000歐元轉換成美元。之後，我想知道2018年加拉巴哥群島的海龜人口，並包括物種信息。然後，我需要計劃從紐約到洛杉磯的旅行，但我想避免收費站和渡輪。最後，我需要將3000英鎊轉換成日圓。"

function.name: convert_currency
function.description: Converts an amount from a particular currency to another currency. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

base_currency.description: The base currency in which the original amount is present.

target_currency.description: The currency to which you want to convert.

function.name: map_service_get_directions
function.description: Retrieve directions from a starting location to an ending location, including options for route preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. Default is none if not specified.

function.name: ecology_get_turtle_population
function.description: Get the population and species of turtles in a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: The year of the data requested. Default is the current year.

species.description: Whether to include species information. Default is false. (optional)

3. Plan directions from New York to Los Angeles avoiding tolls and ferries.
4. Convert 3000 GBP to JPY.

We need to call each function accordingly. We should do them sequentially or maybe combine? The user wants all four tasks. We'll call convert_currency twice: once for EUR to USD, once for GBP to JPY. Then ecology_get_turtle_population for Galapagos Islands, year=2018, species=true. Then map_service_get_directions from New York to Los Angeles, avoid tolls and ferries.

We need to output the results. According to guidelines, we should call the function and then respond with the result. But we can also combine calls? Usually we call one function at a time. First, convert 5000 EUR to USD. Use convert_currency with base_currency="EUR", target_currency="USD", amount=5000.

Then get turtle population: ecology_get_turtle_population with location="Galapagos Islands", year=2018, species=True.

Then map directions: map_service_get_directions start="New York", end="Los Angeles", avoid=["tolls","ferries"].

Then convert 3000 GBP to JPY: convert_currency with base_currency="GBP", target_currency="JPY", amount=3000.
